clearable.description: Defaulted to "always" so user can clear the time whenever there's a value.

emptyValueLabel.description: Add a custom value to display when no time is selected

invalid.description: Highlights the field red and shows message below (if string) to indicate an error

name.description:
Adding a `name` would make this component "Form controlled" and must be
nested within a `<Form />` component.

Cannot be declared if `value` prop is used.

onChange.description: The callback that fires whenever a time gets selected.

placeholder.description: Hint text that goes above the value once the field is filled out

showIcon.description: Hide or show the timer icon.

showMiniLabel.description:
Controls the visibility of the mini label that appears inside the input
when a value is entered. By default, the placeholder text moves up to
become a mini label. Set to false to disable this behavior.

type.description:
Adjusts the UX of the time picker based on where you'd use it.

- `"granular"` - allows the user to pick a very specific time
- `"scheduling"` - only allows user to select between 5 minutes interval.
   If your design is catered towards "scheduling", you should use this type.

validations.description:
Shows an error message below the field and highlights it red when the
value is invalid. Only applies when nested within a `<Form />` component.

value.description:
The value shown on the field. This gets automatically formatted to the
account's time format.
